articles.title: Peace Talks in Kyiv: US Envoys Meet Zelensky
articles.summary: US envoys met Ukraine's president to talk peace. They also met Russia's leader. Both sides agreed to stop attacking each other's capitals for 3 days. Will it lead to peace?

articles.title: Texas BBQ Gets a Halal Makeover
articles.summary: Muslim pitmasters in Texas are putting a new spin on barbecue with halal meats. From brisket shawarma to 13-spice Wagyu, these spots are a hit. Even a former tech guy joined in.

articles.title: Last-Second Goal Stuns United!
articles.summary: Everton's new player Ainsley Maitland-Niles scored a 30-yard screamer with the last kick of the game to tie Manchester United 2-2. It was his debut!
